openai.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
openai.summary: OpenAI receives the conversation and character instructions sent for a reply. The OpenAI Services Agreement and the data controls for the operator's API account govern handling and retention; this summary does not certify the key's training settings. The OpenAI Services Agreement page is the authority.

anthropic.title: Anthropic API terms
anthropic.summary: Anthropic receives the conversation and character instructions sent for a reply. Its Commercial Terms and the operator's account arrangements govern handling and retention; this summary does not certify the key's training settings. Anthropic's own Commercial Terms page is the authority.

gemini.title: Google Gemini API terms
gemini.summary: Google receives the conversation and character instructions sent for a reply. Handling, retention and permitted use can depend on the Gemini API service and billing arrangement, so a key's training settings need checking. Google's own Gemini API Additional Terms page is the authority.

xai.title: Terms of Service - Enterprise
xai.summary: xAI receives the conversation and character instructions sent for a reply. Its API agreement and the operator's account settings govern handling and retention; this summary does not certify the key's training settings. xAI's own Terms of Service - Enterprise page is the authority.

compatible.title: Selected host API terms
compatible.summary: The selected host receives the conversation and character instructions sent for a reply. Its handling, retention and training rules depend on that vendor and account; a compatible interface makes no promise about them. The selected vendor's own API terms page is the authority and must be checked for this host.
